description: Post it: publish or schedule organic posts (not ads) to your own Facebook Pages, Instagram and TikTok accounts. 1) Accounts are connected once, in the web app at https://app.adgpt.com/creative/hosted (a browser sign-in with each platform; it cannot be done here). listAccounts shows what is connected; TikTok may show as unavailable until it is approved, and an account with status reconnect_required must be reconnected in the web app. 2) What to post: a campaign creative id (campaignCreatives lists one campaign's postable images and videos) or your own media (upload_… ids from listMedia). To post your own video or photo from a link (Google Drive shared as "Anyone with the link", Dropbox, or a direct file link): call importQuote first (free: the file size and its credit cost); importMedia then spends credits by file size (charged only when the import succeeds; a few imports can run at once); poll mediaStatus every few seconds until status is ready (post its id) or failed (show its error). Your own files are deleted from our servers 7 days after their last post goes out, or 30 days after upload if never posted (never while a post using them is pending). 3) Post: buildDrafts lays several creatives out as a DRAFT posting calendar across the chosen accounts — nothing goes out until approveDrafts (review with listDrafts, adjust a draft with updatePost, or discardDrafts); or schedulePost posts one creative to one or more accounts now, or at scheduled_at. listPosts reads the calendar (from/to); updatePost, publishNow and deletePost manage single posts. A TikTok account needs the tiktok options (privacy_level and the interaction and disclosure choices) on schedulePost and buildDrafts. Actions: listAccounts, campaignCreatives, listMedia, importQuote, importMedia, mediaStatus, buildDrafts, listDrafts, approveDrafts, discardDrafts, listPosts, schedulePost, updatePost, publishNow, deletePost. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.
name: adgpt_post_it
title: Post it (organic posts)
